title: citrus medica var. limetta
intro: Citrus medica var. limetta, commonly known as the sweet lime or limetta, is a species of citrus tree that is widely cultivated for its fruit and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Citrus medica var. limetta include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Citrus medica var. limetta include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Citrus medica var. limetta include flavonoids, limonoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
